taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: gRPC credentials/interceptors; TLS authentication is separate from application authorization

controls.boundary: gRPC method, object and stream authorization — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open service definitions, interceptor registration, gateway mappings and stream handlers. Locate the trusted principal and the point each message selects its resource.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned unary request as the positive control. In a local/authorized stream send one permitted fixture object, then one other-tenant fixture identifier without changing the session. Trace whether only stream establishment is checked while the second message is consumed with service authority. Compare the actual protected reply or state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A gRPC status or a generated stub revealing a method name is not proof. Metadata supplied by a caller is not trusted identity unless the actual transport/verification path establishes it.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Cover unary and streaming entrypoints with authenticated context, then authorize each resource-sensitive message as required by policy. Retest valid streams, denied later messages and cancellation cleanup.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
